name: injection
description: SQLi, XSS, SSTI, command injection detection. Targets endpoints with parameters found during recon and content discovery. Uses dalfox for XSS, sqlmap for SQLi, commix for command injection, and nuclei injection templates.

quick.description: Nuclei injection templates + dalfox on parameterized URLs. ~25 min.

standard.description: dalfox + sqlmap on forms and params + commix + nuclei injection tags. ~90 min.

exhaustive.description: All standard + deep sqlmap (level 5) + blind XSS + SSTI + commix all techniques. ~4 hours.

author: bb-beast
